not_our_data: Tasks and reminders live in macOS Reminders — the owner deletes them in Apple app and nothing here is involved. Voice notes already have DELETE /voice-notes/:noteId, which removes the words and reaps the audio. Both are solved and need no policy.
the_actual_subject: Facts this system EXTRACTS unasked from what was said, into facts.json and the context graph. The owner cannot see that list, so cannot ask for an item to be removed. That invisibility is the defect, not deletion mechanics.
policy: Anything extracted without being asked for must be listable and individually deletable, or it must not be extracted. Prefer showing over remembering. A fact that cannot be surfaced in a form the owner would recognise is a reason not to store it.
erase_scope: The extracted fact, its derived copies, and the evidence capsule it came from. NOT the job history — that is the audit trail of what this system did on the owner Mac, and deleting evidence of an action is a separate act that must be asked for separately.
audio: Unchanged: microSD only when an upload could not be delivered, removed on acknowledgement.
off_machine: Relay D1 rows and R2 objects are in scope but replicated; report an erase there as requested-and-pending, never as done.
